findings.location: “Kwa maana tumefukuzwa kwa tumaini; lakini tumaini uliyoonekana sio tumaini; kwa maana kilichoonekana mtu kwa nini bado atamtegemea?” (Warumi 8:24).
findings.source_quote: “For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?” (Romans 8:24).
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the incorrect verb "tumefukuzwa" with wording that faithfully renders the English meaning of being saved/justified by hope. For example: “Kwa maana tumeokolewa kwa tumaini; lakini tumaini uliyoonekana si tumaini; kwa maana kilichoonekana, kwa nini mtu bado atatumaini?” Ensure the sentence preserves the negative clause and question structure.
findings.translation_quote: “Kwa maana tumefukuzwa kwa tumaini; lakini tumaini uliyoonekana sio tumaini; kwa maana kilichoonekana mtu kwa nini bado atamtegemea?” (Warumi 8:24).

findings.suggested_fix: Use a title that preserves the English grammatical sense and impersonal passive, e.g. “Kuokolewa kwa Tumaini” or “Tumeokolewa kwa Tumaini” depending on intended voice. If the original treats salvation as a present reality for believers generally, prefer “Kuokolewa kwa Tumaini.”

findings.location: “Msitumie bidii kupata chakula kinachokufa, bali mfanyieni kazi kile chakula kinachodumu uzima wa milele, ambacho Mwana wa Adamu atawakabidhi; kwa maana Baba amefunga alama kwake” (Yohana 6:27).
findings.source_quote: “Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed” (John 6:27).
findings.suggested_fix: Adjust the Kiswahili imperative and the final clause for natural, faithful rendering. For example: “Msifanye kazi kwa ajili ya chakula kinachokufa, bali mfanye kazi kwa ajili ya chakula kinachodumu milele, ambacho Mwana wa Adamu atawapatia; kwa maana Baba amemweka alama kwake.” Alternatively, “Msitafute kwa bidii chakula kinachokufa; badala yake tumieni bidii kutafuta chakula kinachodumu uzima wa milele, ambacho Mwana wa Adamu atawakabidhi, maana Baba amemweka alama kwake.” Preserve the verse reference and sentence structure.
findings.translation_quote: “Msitumie bidii kupata chakula kinachokufa, bali mfanyieni kazi kile chakula kinachodumu uzima wa milele, ambacho Mwana wa Adamu atawakabidhi; kwa maana Baba amefunga alama kwake” (Yohana 6:27).

findings.location: “Sharti la neema ni kwamba tumtumaini Yeye.”
findings.source_quote: “The condition of grace is that we believe on Him.” (context from passage)
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the verb phrase “tumtumaini” (not standard). Use an idiomatic Kiswahili verb for believing on Him, for example: “Sharti la neema ni kwamba tumemwamini Yeye” or “Sharti la neema ni tumwamini Yeye.”
findings.translation_quote: “Sharti la neema ni kwamba tumtumaini Yeye.”
